description: A painting of a wooden lectern in the foreground, with a dark book (apparently a Bible) resting on it. Behind it stretches a large crowd in dark winter coats and hats, facing a neoclassical domed building with American flags and red-white-blue bunting, and a tall obelisk on the right. The sky is heavy and stormy. There is no visible text, and the image runs edge to edge with no frame.
